body.en:
The IC 555 is a very popular, low-cost integrated circuit used to produce accurate time delays and oscillations (square / rectangular waves). It is commonly called the 555 timer.

History

  • Designed by Hans R. Camenzind and introduced by Signetics Corporation in 1971 (part number NE555).
  • The name "555" is usually explained by the three 5 kΩ resistors used inside the IC as a voltage divider.
  • It is one of the most widely produced ICs in the world – billions are made every year.

Versions of 555

VersionDescription
NE555Commercial grade, 0 °C to 70 °C
SE555Military grade, −55 °C to +125 °C
556Dual timer – two 555 timers in one 14-pin IC
558Quad timer – four timers in one 16-pin IC
7555 / TLC555 / LMC555CMOS versions – very low power, can work from about 2 V

Packages

It is available as an 8-pin DIP (Dual In-line Package), 8-pin metal can (TO-99) and 8-pin SMD (SOIC) package. The 8-pin DIP is used in the laboratory.

ઇતિહાસ

  • Hans R. Camenzind એ ડિઝાઇન કર્યું અને Signetics Corporation એ 1971 માં રજૂ કર્યું (part number NE555).
  • "555" નામ સામાન્ય રીતે IC ની અંદર voltage divider તરીકે વપરાતા ત્રણ 5 kΩ resistors પરથી સમજાવાય છે.
  • દુનિયામાં સૌથી વધુ બનતા ICs માંનું એક છે – દર વર્ષે અબજો બને છે.

7555 / TLC555 / LMC555CMOS versions – ખૂબ ઓછો power, લગભગ 2 V થી પણ કામ કરે

Packages

તે 8-pin DIP (Dual In-line Package), 8-pin metal can (TO-99) અને 8-pin SMD (SOIC) package માં મળે છે. Laboratory માં 8-pin DIP વપરાય છે.

body.en:
• Wide supply voltage: +4.5 V to +15 V (maximum 16–18 V, depending on manufacturer).
  • Timing range: from a few microseconds to hours, set by external R and C only.
  • High output current: output can source or sink up to 200 mA – can drive LEDs, relays, buzzers and small lamps directly.
  • Output compatible with TTL logic when operated from a 5 V supply.
  • Adjustable duty cycle in astable mode.
  • High temperature stability: about 0.005 % per °C.
  • Timing is independent of supply voltage because the thresholds are fixed fractions (⅔ and ⅓) of VCC.
  • Works in monostable, astable and bistable modes.
  • Small size, low cost, easily available and needs very few external components.

The 555 timer can be operated in three basic modes:

ModeOther nameStable statesOutputUses
MonostableOne-shot multivibratorOne (LOW)One pulse of fixed width T = 1.1RC for each triggerTimers, delay circuits, pulse stretching, debouncing
AstableFree-running multivibratorNone (both quasi-stable)Continuous rectangular wave, no trigger neededOscillators, LED flashers, clock pulses, tone generators

Multivibrator: a circuit that switches between two states (HIGH and LOW). The number of stable states gives its type: mono (1), a-stable (0), bi-stable (2).

body.en:
Advantages

  • Very cheap, easily available, simple to use.
  • Wide range of supply voltage and timing.
  • High output current (200 mA) – drives loads directly.
  • Timing does not depend on supply voltage; good temperature stability.

Limitations

  • The bipolar NE555 draws a large current spike during output switching; needs a decoupling capacitor across the supply.
  • Maximum frequency about 500 kHz – not suitable for very high frequencies.
  • For very long delays, large capacitors are needed; leakage of electrolytic capacitors reduces accuracy.
  • In the basic astable circuit the duty cycle is always more than 50 %.

Applications

Pulse generator, square-wave oscillator, time-delay circuit, LED flasher, traffic-light timer, burglar alarm, missing-pulse detector, frequency divider, PWM (pulse width modulation), frequency counter (gate pulse), tone / siren generator, touch switch, water-level indicator, DC-DC converter, etc.
body.gu:
ફાયદા

  • ખૂબ સસ્તું, સહેલાઈથી મળે, વાપરવામાં સરળ.
  • Supply voltage અને timing ની વિશાળ range.
  • વધુ output current (200 mA) – loads ને સીધા ચલાવે.
  • Timing supply voltage પર આધાર રાખતું નથી; સારી temperature stability.

મર્યાદાઓ

  • Bipolar NE555 output switching વખતે મોટો current spike લે છે; supply પર decoupling capacitor જોઈએ.
  • મહત્તમ frequency લગભગ 500 kHz – ખૂબ ઊંચી frequencies માટે યોગ્ય નથી.
  • ખૂબ લાંબા delay માટે મોટા capacitors જોઈએ; electrolytic capacitors નો leakage ચોકસાઈ ઘટાડે.
  • Basic astable circuit માં duty cycle હંમેશા 50 % થી વધુ હોય છે.

ઉપયોગો

Pulse generator, square-wave oscillator, time-delay circuit, LED flasher, traffic-light timer, burglar alarm, missing-pulse detector, frequency divider, PWM (pulse width modulation), frequency counter (gate pulse), tone / siren generator, touch switch, water-level indicator, DC-DC converter વગેરે.

body.en:
IC 555 in an 8-pin DIP package has four pins on each side. Looking from the top, with the notch upward, pin 1 is at the top-left (near the dot / notch) and pins are numbered anticlockwise: 1 → 4 down the left side and 5 → 8 up the right side.

PinNamePinName

2Trigger7Discharge
3Output6Threshold
4Reset5Control Voltage

Memory tip: opposite pins add up to 9 → (1, 8) supply pins, (2, 7), (3, 6), (4, 5).

8-pin DIP package વાળા IC 555 માં દરેક બાજુ ચાર pins છે. Notch ઉપર રાખી ઉપરથી જોતાં pin 1 ઉપર-ડાબી બાજુ (dot / notch પાસે) હોય છે અને pins anticlockwise ગણાય છે: ડાબી બાજુ નીચે 1 → 4 અને જમણી બાજુ ઉપર 5 → 8.

PinનામPinનામ
1Ground (GND)8+VCC
2Trigger7Discharge
3Output6Threshold
4Reset5Control Voltage

યાદ રાખવાની રીત: સામ-સામેના pins નો સરવાળો 9 → (1, 8) supply pins, (2, 7), (3, 6), (4, 5).

body.en:
Pin 1 – Ground (GND)

All voltages are measured with respect to this pin. It is connected to the negative terminal (0 V) of the supply.

Pin 2 – Trigger

  • It is the inverting (−) input of the lower comparator (comparator 2). Its other input is fixed at ⅓VCC.
  • When the voltage at pin 2 falls below ⅓VCC, the comparator output goes HIGH and sets the flip-flop → output (pin 3) goes HIGH.
  • In monostable mode, a negative-going trigger pulse is applied here to start the timing.
  • Normally kept above ⅓VCC using a pull-up resistor.

Pin 3 – Output

  • Output of the timer, taken from a totem-pole output stage.
  • HIGH ≈ VCC − 1.7 V and LOW ≈ 0 V.
  • Can source current (load between pin 3 and ground, ON when output HIGH) or sink current (load between VCC and pin 3, ON when output LOW), up to 200 mA.

Pin 4 – Reset

  • Active-LOW reset input. When a voltage below about 0.7 V is applied, the flip-flop is reset: output goes LOW and the discharge transistor turns ON, whatever the other inputs.
  • It has the highest priority over all other inputs.
  • When not used, it is connected to +VCC to avoid false resetting by noise.
body.gu:
Pin 1 – Ground (GND)

બધા voltages આ pin ના સંદર્ભમાં માપાય છે. તેને supply ના negative terminal (0 V) સાથે જોડાય છે.

Pin 2 – Trigger

  • તે નીચેના comparator (comparator 2) નો inverting (−) input છે. તેનો બીજો input ⅓VCC પર નિશ્ચિત છે.
  • Pin 2 નો voltage ⅓VCC થી નીચે જાય ત્યારે comparator output HIGH થાય અને flip-flop ને set કરે → output (pin 3) HIGH થાય.
  • Monostable mode માં timing શરૂ કરવા અહીં negative-going trigger pulse અપાય છે.
  • સામાન્ય રીતે pull-up resistor વડે ⅓VCC થી ઉપર રખાય છે.

Pin 3 – Output

  • Timer નો output, totem-pole output stage માંથી લેવાય છે.
  • HIGH ≈ VCC − 1.7 V અને LOW ≈ 0 V.
  • Source current (load pin 3 અને ground વચ્ચે, output HIGH હોય ત્યારે ON) અથવા sink current (load VCC અને pin 3 વચ્ચે, output LOW હોય ત્યારે ON) 200 mA સુધી આપી શકે.

Pin 4 – Reset

  • Active-LOW reset input. લગભગ 0.7 V થી ઓછો voltage આપતાં flip-flop reset થાય: બીજા inputs ગમે તે હોય તો પણ output LOW થાય અને discharge transistor ON થાય.
  • બધા inputs કરતાં તેની priority સૌથી વધુ છે.
  • ઉપયોગ ન હોય ત્યારે noise થી ખોટું reset ન થાય તે માટે તેને +VCC સાથે જોડાય છે.

body.en:
Pin 5 – Control Voltage (CV)

  • It is connected directly to the ⅔VCC point of the internal voltage divider (inverting input of the upper comparator).
  • By applying an external voltage here, the threshold levels can be changed: upper = VCON, lower = VCON/2. This changes the timing / frequency → used for PWM and voltage-controlled oscillators (VCO).
  • When not used, it is connected to ground through a 0.01 µF capacitor to bypass noise and keep the thresholds stable.

Pin 6 – Threshold

  • It is the non-inverting (+) input of the upper comparator (comparator 1), compared with ⅔VCC.
  • When the voltage at pin 6 rises above ⅔VCC, the comparator output goes HIGH and resets the flip-flop → output goes LOW.
  • Usually connected to the timing capacitor, which it monitors.

Pin 7 – Discharge

  • Connected to the open collector of the internal discharge transistor (Qd).
  • When output is LOW, Qd is ON (saturated) and gives a discharge path to the timing capacitor. When output is HIGH, Qd is OFF and the capacitor can charge.

Pin 8 – +VCC

Positive supply pin, +4.5 V to +15 V with respect to pin 1. A 0.1 µF decoupling capacitor between pins 8 and 1 is recommended.
body.gu:
Pin 5 – Control Voltage (CV)

  • તે અંદરના voltage divider ના ⅔VCC બિંદુ (ઉપરના comparator નો inverting input) સાથે સીધો જોડાયેલો છે.
  • અહીં બહારનો voltage આપીને threshold levels બદલી શકાય: upper = VCON, lower = VCON/2. તેથી timing / frequency બદલાય → PWM અને voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) માટે વપરાય.
  • ઉપયોગ ન હોય ત્યારે noise bypass કરવા અને thresholds સ્થિર રાખવા તેને 0.01 µF capacitor દ્વારા ground સાથે જોડાય છે.

Pin 6 – Threshold

  • તે ઉપરના comparator (comparator 1) નો non-inverting (+) input છે, જેની સરખામણી ⅔VCC સાથે થાય છે.
  • Pin 6 નો voltage ⅔VCC થી ઉપર જાય ત્યારે comparator output HIGH થાય અને flip-flop ને reset કરે → output LOW થાય.
  • સામાન્ય રીતે timing capacitor સાથે જોડાય છે અને તેના voltage પર નજર રાખે છે.

Pin 7 – Discharge

  • અંદરના discharge transistor (Qd) ના open collector સાથે જોડાયેલો છે.
  • Output LOW હોય ત્યારે Qd ON (saturated) હોય અને timing capacitor ને discharge path આપે. Output HIGH હોય ત્યારે Qd OFF હોય અને capacitor charge થઈ શકે.

Pin 8 – +VCC

Positive supply pin, pin 1 ના સંદર્ભમાં +4.5 V થી +15 V. Pins 8 અને 1 વચ્ચે 0.1 µF decoupling capacitor રાખવાની ભલામણ છે.

body.en:
• Pins: 1 GND, 2 Trigger, 3 Output, 4 Reset, 5 Control, 6 Threshold, 7 Discharge, 8 VCC.
  • Trigger (2) < ⅓VCC → output HIGH; Threshold (6) > ⅔VCC → output LOW.
  • Reset (4) is active LOW → tie to VCC when unused.
  • Control (5) → 0.01 µF to ground when unused; external voltage changes the thresholds.
  • Discharge (7) → shorts the timing capacitor to ground when output is LOW.
  • Output (3) sources / sinks up to 200 mA.

body.en:
The internal circuit of IC 555 contains about 25 transistors, 2 diodes and 15 resistors. Functionally it can be represented by the following blocks (see diagram):

1. Voltage divider

Three equal 5 kΩ resistors connected in series between VCC (pin 8) and ground (pin 1). They produce two reference voltages:

  • ⅔VCC at the junction of the upper two resistors (also brought out at pin 5) → reference for the upper comparator.
  • ⅓VCC at the junction of the lower two resistors → reference for the lower comparator.

2. Upper comparator (Comparator 1 – threshold comparator)

(+) input = threshold (pin 6), (−) input = ⅔VCC. Its output goes HIGH when V6 > ⅔VCC. It drives the R (reset) input of the flip-flop.

3. Lower comparator (Comparator 2 – trigger comparator)

(+) input = ⅓VCC, (−) input = trigger (pin 2). Its output goes HIGH when V2 < ⅓VCC. It drives the S (set) input of the flip-flop.

4. SR flip-flop (control flip-flop)

Stores the state. S = 1 → Q = 1, Q̄ = 0; R = 1 → Q = 0, Q̄ = 1. The Q̄ output controls both the output stage and the discharge transistor.

5. Output stage (power amplifier / inverting buffer)

An inverting totem-pole amplifier driven by Q̄. So the output (pin 3) = Q. It gives the high current capability (200 mA) and isolates the flip-flop from the load.

6. Discharge transistor (Qd)

An NPN transistor with its base driven by Q̄, emitter grounded, and collector at pin 7. When Q̄ = 1 (output LOW) it is ON and discharges the external capacitor; when Q̄ = 0 (output HIGH) it is OFF.

7. Reset

Pin 4 directly resets the flip-flop when taken LOW (active-LOW), overriding all other inputs.
body.gu:
IC 555 ના અંદરના circuit માં લગભગ 25 transistors, 2 diodes અને 15 resistors હોય છે. કાર્યની દૃષ્ટિએ તેને નીચેના blocks વડે દર્શાવી શકાય (આકૃતિ જુઓ):

1. Voltage divider

VCC (pin 8) અને ground (pin 1) વચ્ચે series માં જોડાયેલા ત્રણ સમાન 5 kΩ resistors. તેઓ બે reference voltages બનાવે છે:

  • ઉપરના બે resistors ના જોડાણ પર ⅔VCC (pin 5 પર પણ બહાર લાવેલ) → ઉપરના comparator માટે reference.
  • નીચેના બે resistors ના જોડાણ પર ⅓VCC → નીચેના comparator માટે reference.

2. ઉપરનો comparator (Comparator 1 – threshold comparator)

(+) input = threshold (pin 6), (−) input = ⅔VCC. V6 > ⅔VCC થાય ત્યારે તેનો output HIGH થાય. તે flip-flop ના R (reset) input ને ચલાવે છે.

3. નીચેનો comparator (Comparator 2 – trigger comparator)

(+) input = ⅓VCC, (−) input = trigger (pin 2). V2 < ⅓VCC થાય ત્યારે તેનો output HIGH થાય. તે flip-flop ના S (set) input ને ચલાવે છે.

4. SR flip-flop (control flip-flop)

State ને સંગ્રહે છે. S = 1 → Q = 1, Q̄ = 0; R = 1 → Q = 0, Q̄ = 1. Q̄ output, output stage અને discharge transistor બંનેને control કરે છે.

5. Output stage (power amplifier / inverting buffer)

Q̄ થી ચાલતો inverting totem-pole amplifier. તેથી output (pin 3) = Q. તે વધુ current ક્ષમતા (200 mA) આપે છે અને flip-flop ને load થી અલગ રાખે છે.

6. Discharge transistor (Qd)

NPN transistor જેનો base Q̄ થી ચાલે, emitter ground પર અને collector pin 7 પર છે. Q̄ = 1 (output LOW) હોય ત્યારે તે ON થઈ બહારના capacitor ને discharge કરે; Q̄ = 0 (output HIGH) હોય ત્યારે OFF રહે.

7. Reset

Pin 4 ને LOW કરતાં (active-LOW) તે બીજા બધા inputs ને અવગણી flip-flop ને સીધો reset કરે છે.

body.en:
The working depends on the voltages at the trigger (pin 2) and threshold (pin 6) compared with ⅓VCC and ⅔VCC:

  1. Trigger < ⅓VCC: lower comparator output = 1 → S = 1 → flip-flop set, Q = 1, Q̄ = 0 → output HIGH, discharge transistor OFF → external capacitor can charge.
  2. Threshold > ⅔VCC: upper comparator output = 1 → R = 1 → flip-flop reset, Q = 0, Q̄ = 1 → output LOW, discharge transistor ON → capacitor discharges through pin 7.
  3. Trigger > ⅓VCC and threshold < ⅔VCC: both comparator outputs = 0 → S = R = 0 → flip-flop keeps its previous state (no change).
  4. Reset (pin 4) LOW: output LOW, discharge ON, regardless of other inputs.

Function table

Reset (4)Trigger (2)Threshold (6)Output (3)Discharge (7)
LOWXXLOWON (grounded)
HIGH< ⅓VCCXHIGHOFF (open)
HIGH> ⅓VCC> ⅔VCCLOWON (grounded)
HIGH> ⅓VCC< ⅔VCCNo changeNo change

(X = don't care.) In short: the trigger turns the output ON, the threshold turns it OFF. The external R and C decide how long it takes the capacitor voltage to move between ⅓VCC and ⅔VCC; this sets the timing.

Effect of control voltage

If a voltage VCON is applied at pin 5, the upper threshold becomes VCON and the lower threshold becomes VCON/2.
body.gu:
કાર્ય trigger (pin 2) અને threshold (pin 6) ના voltages ની ⅓VCC અને ⅔VCC સાથેની સરખામણી પર આધાર રાખે છે:

  1. Trigger < ⅓VCC: નીચેના comparator નો output = 1 → S = 1 → flip-flop set, Q = 1, Q̄ = 0 → output HIGH, discharge transistor OFF → બહારનો capacitor charge થઈ શકે.
  2. Threshold > ⅔VCC: ઉપરના comparator નો output = 1 → R = 1 → flip-flop reset, Q = 0, Q̄ = 1 → output LOW, discharge transistor ON → capacitor pin 7 દ્વારા discharge થાય.
  3. Trigger > ⅓VCC અને threshold < ⅔VCC: બંને comparator outputs = 0 → S = R = 0 → flip-flop અગાઉની state જાળવી રાખે (કોઈ ફેરફાર નહીં).
  4. Reset (pin 4) LOW: બીજા inputs ગમે તે હોય, output LOW અને discharge ON.

Function table

Reset (4)Trigger (2)Threshold (6)Output (3)Discharge (7)
LOWXXLOWON (grounded)
HIGH< ⅓VCCXHIGHOFF (open)
HIGH> ⅓VCC> ⅔VCCLOWON (grounded)
HIGH> ⅓VCC< ⅔VCCફેરફાર નહીંફેરફાર નહીં

(X = don't care.) ટૂંકમાં: trigger output ને ON કરે, threshold તેને OFF કરે. બહારના R અને C નક્કી કરે છે કે capacitor voltage ને ⅓VCC અને ⅔VCC વચ્ચે જતાં કેટલો સમય લાગે; આનાથી timing નક્કી થાય છે.

Control voltage ની અસર

Pin 5 પર VCON voltage આપીએ તો upper threshold VCON અને lower threshold VCON/2 બને છે.

body.en:
• Blocks: 3 × 5 kΩ divider, 2 comparators, SR flip-flop, output stage, discharge transistor, reset.
  • Divider gives references ⅔VCC (upper comparator) and ⅓VCC (lower comparator).
  • Upper comparator → R input (threshold > ⅔VCC → output LOW).
  • Lower comparator → S input (trigger < ⅓VCC → output HIGH).
  • Output LOW ⇔ discharge transistor ON; output HIGH ⇔ discharge transistor OFF.
  • With pin 5 voltage VCON: thresholds = VCON and VCON/2.

h.en: 5.4.1 555 as Monostable Multivibrator – Circuit and Working
h.gu: 5.4.1 Monostable Multivibrator તરીકે 555 – Circuit અને કાર્ય

body.en:
A monostable multivibrator (one-shot) has one stable state (output LOW) and one quasi-stable (temporary) state (output HIGH). When triggered, the output goes HIGH for a fixed time T = 1.1RC and then returns to LOW by itself.

Circuit (see diagram)

  • Pin 8 and pin 4 → +VCC; pin 1 → ground; pin 5 → 0.01 µF to ground.
  • Timing resistor R from VCC to pins 6 and 7 (joined together); timing capacitor C from pins 6/7 to ground.
  • Trigger input at pin 2, held HIGH by a 10 kΩ pull-up; a push switch (or negative pulse) pulls it LOW.
  • Output at pin 3 (e.g. LED with series resistor).

Working

  1. Stable state: Trigger is HIGH (> ⅓VCC). Flip-flop is reset, Q̄ = 1 → output LOW, discharge transistor ON → capacitor C is shorted, VC ≈ 0. The circuit stays like this indefinitely.
  2. Triggering: A negative-going pulse at pin 2 takes it below ⅓VCC. The lower comparator sets the flip-flop → Q̄ = 0 → output HIGH, discharge transistor OFF.
  3. Timing (quasi-stable state): C now charges through R towards VCC (exponentially, time constant RC).
  4. End of pulse: When VC reaches ⅔VCC, the upper comparator resets the flip-flop → output LOW, discharge transistor ON → C discharges quickly to 0 V.
  5. The circuit is back in its stable state and waits for the next trigger.

Pulse width: T = 1.1 RC (seconds, with R in Ω and C in F).

Important points

  • The trigger pulse must be shorter than T; otherwise the output stays HIGH as long as the trigger is LOW.
  • Further triggers during the timing period have no effect (non-retriggerable).
  • Applying LOW to reset (pin 4) during timing ends the pulse immediately.
  • Applications: time delay, timer, pulse stretching, switch debouncing, missing-pulse detector, frequency divider, gate pulse for frequency counter.
body.gu:
Monostable multivibrator (one-shot) માં એક stable state (output LOW) અને એક quasi-stable (કામચલાઉ) state (output HIGH) હોય છે. Trigger મળતાં output નિશ્ચિત સમય T = 1.1RC માટે HIGH થાય અને પછી આપોઆપ LOW થઈ જાય.

Circuit (આકૃતિ જુઓ)

  • Pin 8 અને pin 4 → +VCC; pin 1 → ground; pin 5 → 0.01 µF દ્વારા ground.
  • Timing resistor R VCC થી pins 6 અને 7 (એકસાથે જોડેલા) સુધી; timing capacitor C pins 6/7 થી ground સુધી.
  • Pin 2 પર trigger input, 10 kΩ pull-up વડે HIGH રાખેલ; push switch (અથવા negative pulse) તેને LOW કરે.
  • Pin 3 પર output (દા.ત. series resistor સાથે LED).

કાર્ય

  1. Stable state: Trigger HIGH (> ⅓VCC) છે. Flip-flop reset, Q̄ = 1 → output LOW, discharge transistor ON → capacitor C short, VC ≈ 0. Circuit અનિશ્ચિત સમય સુધી આમ જ રહે.
  2. Triggering: Pin 2 પર negative-going pulse તેને ⅓VCC થી નીચે લઈ જાય. નીચેનો comparator flip-flop ને set કરે → Q̄ = 0 → output HIGH, discharge transistor OFF.
  3. Timing (quasi-stable state): હવે C, R દ્વારા charge થઈ VCC તરફ જાય (exponential, time constant RC).
  4. Pulse નો અંત: VC ⅔VCC પર પહોંચે ત્યારે ઉપરનો comparator flip-flop ને reset કરે → output LOW, discharge transistor ON → C ઝડપથી 0 V સુધી discharge થાય.
  5. Circuit ફરી stable state માં આવે અને આગલા trigger ની રાહ જુએ.

Pulse width: T = 1.1 RC (seconds, R Ω માં અને C F માં).

મહત્વના મુદ્દા

  • Trigger pulse T કરતાં ટૂંકો હોવો જોઈએ; નહીં તો trigger LOW રહે ત્યાં સુધી output HIGH રહે.
  • Timing દરમિયાન આવતા બીજા triggers ની કોઈ અસર નથી (non-retriggerable).
  • Timing દરમિયાન reset (pin 4) ને LOW કરતાં pulse તરત પૂરો થાય.
  • ઉપયોગો: time delay, timer, pulse stretching, switch debouncing, missing-pulse detector, frequency divider, frequency counter માટે gate pulse.

body.en:
Waveforms (see diagram)

  • Trigger (pin 2): normally HIGH; a short negative pulse below ⅓VCC starts the cycle.
  • Output (pin 3): goes HIGH at the trigger instant and stays HIGH for time T, then LOW.
  • Capacitor voltage VC (pins 6, 7): rises exponentially from 0 to ⅔VCC during T, then falls suddenly to 0 when discharged.

Derivation of T = 1.1RC

During the timing period C charges from 0 V towards VCC through R:

VC = VCC (1 − e−t/RC)

The pulse ends when VC = ⅔VCC at t = T:

⅔VCC = VCC (1 − e−T/RC) → e−T/RC = ⅓ → T/RC = ln 3 = 1.0986

T = 1.0986 RC ≈ 1.1 RC

Note: VCC cancels out, so the pulse width does not depend on the supply voltage. It depends only on R and C.

Choice of components

  • R: about 1 kΩ to 1 MΩ (higher values make leakage currents important).
  • C: about 470 pF to a few hundred µF; use low-leakage capacitors for long delays.
  • To vary T, use a potentiometer (with a series fixed resistor) in place of R.
body.gu:
Waveforms (આકૃતિ જુઓ)

  • Trigger (pin 2): સામાન્ય રીતે HIGH; ⅓VCC થી નીચેનો ટૂંકો negative pulse cycle શરૂ કરે.
  • Output (pin 3): trigger ની ક્ષણે HIGH થાય, T સમય સુધી HIGH રહે, પછી LOW.
  • Capacitor voltage VC (pins 6, 7): T દરમિયાન 0 થી ⅔VCC સુધી exponential રીતે વધે, પછી discharge થતાં અચાનક 0 થાય.

T = 1.1RC ની સાબિતી (Derivation)

Timing સમય દરમિયાન C, R દ્વારા 0 V થી VCC તરફ charge થાય છે:

VC = VCC (1 − e−t/RC)

t = T પર VC = ⅔VCC થાય ત્યારે pulse પૂરો થાય:

⅔VCC = VCC (1 − e−T/RC) → e−T/RC = ⅓ → T/RC = ln 3 = 1.0986

T = 1.0986 RC ≈ 1.1 RC

નોંધ: VCC cancel થઈ જાય છે, તેથી pulse width supply voltage પર આધાર રાખતી નથી. તે ફક્ત R અને C પર આધાર રાખે છે.

Components ની પસંદગી

  • R: લગભગ 1 kΩ થી 1 MΩ (વધુ મૂલ્યે leakage currents મહત્વના બને).
  • C: લગભગ 470 pF થી થોડા સો µF; લાંબા delay માટે low-leakage capacitors વાપરો.
  • T બદલવા R ની જગ્યાએ potentiometer (series fixed resistor સાથે) વાપરો.

h.en: 5.4.3 555 as Astable Multivibrator (Oscillator) – Circuit and Working
h.gu: 5.4.3 Astable Multivibrator (Oscillator) તરીકે 555 – Circuit અને કાર્ય

body.en:
An astable multivibrator has no stable state. Its output switches continuously between HIGH and LOW without any external trigger, producing a rectangular (square) wave. So it works as a free-running oscillator or clock generator.

Circuit (see diagram)

  • Pin 8 and pin 4 → +VCC; pin 1 → ground; pin 5 → 0.01 µF to ground.
  • RA between VCC and pin 7; RB between pin 7 and pins 6 + 2.
  • Timing capacitor C from pins 6 and 2 (joined together) to ground.
  • Output at pin 3.

Working

  1. At switch-on: VC = 0 < ⅓VCC → trigger comparator sets the flip-flop → output HIGH, discharge transistor OFF.
  2. Charging (tH): C charges through RA + RB towards VCC. Output stays HIGH.
  3. When VC reaches ⅔VCC, the threshold comparator resets the flip-flop → output LOW, discharge transistor ON (pin 7 grounded).
  4. Discharging (tL): C discharges through RB only into pin 7. Output stays LOW.
  5. When VC falls to ⅓VCC, the trigger comparator sets the flip-flop again → output HIGH, discharge OFF, and C starts charging again.
  6. The cycle repeats: VC swings between ⅓VCC and ⅔VCC and the output is a continuous rectangular wave.

Note: the first HIGH period after switch-on is longer (C charges from 0 instead of ⅓VCC), about 1.1(RA + RB)C.

Applications

Square-wave / clock generator, LED flasher, tone and siren generators, metronome, traffic-light sequencer clock, PWM, voltage-controlled oscillator (using pin 5).
body.gu:
Astable multivibrator માં કોઈ stable state નથી. તેનો output બહારના trigger વગર સતત HIGH અને LOW વચ્ચે બદલાતો રહે છે અને rectangular (square) wave બનાવે છે. તેથી તે free-running oscillator અથવા clock generator તરીકે કામ કરે છે.

Circuit (આકૃતિ જુઓ)

  • Pin 8 અને pin 4 → +VCC; pin 1 → ground; pin 5 → 0.01 µF દ્વારા ground.
  • RA VCC અને pin 7 વચ્ચે; RB pin 7 અને pins 6 + 2 વચ્ચે.
  • Timing capacitor C pins 6 અને 2 (એકસાથે જોડેલા) થી ground સુધી.
  • Pin 3 પર output.

કાર્ય

  1. Switch-on વખતે: VC = 0 < ⅓VCC → trigger comparator flip-flop ને set કરે → output HIGH, discharge transistor OFF.
  2. Charging (tH): C, RA + RB દ્વારા VCC તરફ charge થાય. Output HIGH રહે.
  3. VC ⅔VCC પર પહોંચે ત્યારે threshold comparator flip-flop ને reset કરે → output LOW, discharge transistor ON (pin 7 grounded).
  4. Discharging (tL): C ફક્ત RB દ્વારા pin 7 માં discharge થાય. Output LOW રહે.
  5. VC ઘટીને ⅓VCC થાય ત્યારે trigger comparator ફરી flip-flop ને set કરે → output HIGH, discharge OFF, અને C ફરી charge થવા લાગે.
  6. Cycle પુનરાવર્તિત થાય: VC ⅓VCC અને ⅔VCC વચ્ચે ઝૂલે અને output સતત rectangular wave બને.

નોંધ: Switch-on પછીનો પહેલો HIGH સમય લાંબો હોય છે (C, ⅓VCC ની જગ્યાએ 0 થી charge થાય), લગભગ 1.1(RA + RB)C.

ઉપયોગો

Square-wave / clock generator, LED flasher, tone અને siren generators, metronome, traffic-light sequencer clock, PWM, voltage-controlled oscillator (pin 5 વાપરીને).

h.en: 5.4.4 Astable – Waveforms, Frequency and Duty Cycle
h.gu: 5.4.4 Astable – Waveforms, Frequency અને Duty Cycle

body.en:
Waveforms (see diagram)

  • VC: after the first cycle, rises (charging) and falls (discharging) exponentially between ⅓VCC and ⅔VCC.
  • Output: HIGH while C charges (tH), LOW while C discharges (tL).

Derivation of timing

Charging from ⅓VCC to ⅔VCC through (RA + RB):

VC = VCC − (VCC − ⅓VCC) e−t/τ; putting VC = ⅔VCC → ⅓ = ⅔ e−t/τ → t = τ ln 2 = 0.693τ

tH = 0.693 (RA + RB) C

Discharging from ⅔VCC to ⅓VCC through RB: VC = ⅔VCC e−t/RBC = ⅓VCC → t = 0.693 RBC

tL = 0.693 RB C

Total time period and frequency

T = tH + tL = 0.693 (RA + 2RB) C

f = 1/T = 1.44 / [(RA + 2RB) C]

Duty cycle

Duty cycle = ratio of HIGH time to total time:

D = tH / T × 100 % = (RA + RB) / (RA + 2RB) × 100 %

  • Since tH > tL always, the duty cycle of the basic circuit is always more than 50 %.
  • If RB ≫ RA, D approaches 50 % (nearly square wave).
  • Exactly 50 % (or less): connect a diode across RB (anode at pin 7). C then charges through RA and the diode, and discharges through RB, so tH = 0.693RAC and tL = 0.693RBC. With RA = RB, D = 50 %.
  • RA must not be zero, otherwise pin 7 would short VCC when the discharge transistor turns ON (minimum about 1 kΩ).
body.gu:
Waveforms (આકૃતિ જુઓ)

  • VC: પહેલા cycle પછી ⅓VCC અને ⅔VCC વચ્ચે exponential રીતે વધે (charging) અને ઘટે (discharging).
  • Output: C charge થાય ત્યારે HIGH (tH), C discharge થાય ત્યારે LOW (tL).

Timing ની સાબિતી (Derivation)

(RA + RB) દ્વારા ⅓VCC થી ⅔VCC સુધી Charging:

VC = VCC − (VCC − ⅓VCC) e−t/τ; VC = ⅔VCC મૂકતાં → ⅓ = ⅔ e−t/τ → t = τ ln 2 = 0.693τ

tH = 0.693 (RA + RB) C

RB દ્વારા ⅔VCC થી ⅓VCC સુધી Discharging: VC = ⅔VCC e−t/RBC = ⅓VCC → t = 0.693 RBC

tL = 0.693 RB C

કુલ time period અને frequency

T = tH + tL = 0.693 (RA + 2RB) C

f = 1/T = 1.44 / [(RA + 2RB) C]

Duty cycle

Duty cycle = HIGH સમય અને કુલ સમયનો ગુણોત્તર:

D = tH / T × 100 % = (RA + RB) / (RA + 2RB) × 100 %

  • tH > tL હંમેશા હોવાથી basic circuit નો duty cycle હંમેશા 50 % થી વધુ હોય છે.
  • RB ≫ RA હોય તો D લગભગ 50 % (લગભગ square wave).
  • બરાબર 50 % (અથવા ઓછો): RB ની સમાંતર diode (anode pin 7 તરફ) જોડો. પછી C, RA અને diode દ્વારા charge થાય અને RB દ્વારા discharge થાય, તેથી tH = 0.693RAC અને tL = 0.693RBC. RA = RB રાખતાં D = 50 %.
  • RA શૂન્ય ન હોવો જોઈએ, નહીં તો discharge transistor ON થતાં pin 7 VCC ને short કરે (ન્યૂનતમ લગભગ 1 kΩ).

body.en:
A pulse generator produces a continuous train of rectangular pulses of required frequency and width. The astable 555 is the simplest pulse generator. A common laboratory example is the LED flasher (see diagram).

Circuit

  • Basic astable circuit with RA = 10 kΩ, RB = 68 kΩ, C = 10 µF (frequency ≈ 1 Hz).
  • LED2 + 470 Ω from pin 3 to ground → current is sourced by the 555.
  • LED1 + 470 Ω from +VCC to pin 3 → current is sunk by the 555.

Working

  • When output is HIGH (C charging), current flows from pin 3 through LED2 to ground → LED2 ON, LED1 OFF (no voltage across it).
  • When output is LOW (C discharging), current flows from VCC through LED1 into pin 3 → LED1 ON, LED2 OFF.
  • So the two LEDs flash alternately about once per second. For a single flasher, use only one LED.
  • Flash rate is changed by changing RB or C (a potentiometer can be used in place of RB).

Other pulse-generator uses

  • Clock pulses for digital counters and logic circuits (output is TTL compatible at 5 V).
  • Tone / buzzer generator: with small C (e.g. 0.01 µF) the frequency is in the audio range; a speaker gives a tone.
  • PWM generator: varying the voltage at pin 5 changes the pulse width – used in motor speed and LED brightness control.
  • A monostable 555 is used as a single-pulse generator (one clean pulse of fixed width for each trigger).
body.gu:
Pulse generator જરૂરી frequency અને width વાળા rectangular pulses ની સતત હારમાળા બનાવે છે. Astable 555 સૌથી સરળ pulse generator છે. Laboratory નું સામાન્ય ઉદાહરણ LED flasher છે (આકૃતિ જુઓ).

Circuit

  • RA = 10 kΩ, RB = 68 kΩ, C = 10 µF સાથેનો basic astable circuit (frequency ≈ 1 Hz).
  • LED2 + 470 Ω pin 3 થી ground સુધી → 555 current source કરે.
  • LED1 + 470 Ω +VCC થી pin 3 સુધી → 555 current sink કરે.

કાર્ય

  • Output HIGH (C charging) હોય ત્યારે current pin 3 થી LED2 દ્વારા ground માં વહે → LED2 ON, LED1 OFF (તેના પર voltage નથી).
  • Output LOW (C discharging) હોય ત્યારે current VCC થી LED1 દ્વારા pin 3 માં વહે → LED1 ON, LED2 OFF.
  • આમ બંને LEDs લગભગ દર સેકન્ડે વારાફરતી ઝબકે. એક જ flasher માટે ફક્ત એક LED વાપરો.
  • RB અથવા C બદલીને flash rate બદલાય (RB ની જગ્યાએ potentiometer વાપરી શકાય).

Pulse generator ના બીજા ઉપયોગો

  • Digital counters અને logic circuits માટે clock pulses (5 V પર output TTL compatible).
  • Tone / buzzer generator: નાના C (દા.ત. 0.01 µF) સાથે frequency audio range માં આવે; speaker tone આપે.
  • PWM generator: pin 5 નો voltage બદલતાં pulse width બદલાય – motor speed અને LED brightness control માં વપરાય.
  • Monostable 555 single-pulse generator તરીકે વપરાય (દરેક trigger માટે નિશ્ચિત width નો એક સ્વચ્છ pulse).

body.en:
The most direct use of the 555 is as a timer: it keeps a load ON (or OFF) for a fixed, adjustable time after a start signal. The monostable circuit is used for this (see the monostable circuit diagram).

Circuit idea

  • Monostable 555 with timing components R and C (T = 1.1RC). R can be a potentiometer + fixed resistor for adjustable time.
  • A START push button at pin 2 (with 10 kΩ pull-up) triggers the timer.
  • An optional STOP / RESET push button at pin 4 (with pull-up) ends the timing early.
  • Pin 3 drives the load directly (LED, buzzer) or through a relay (with a freewheeling diode across the relay coil) for AC loads such as a lamp.

Working

  1. Pressing START pulls pin 2 below ⅓VCC → output HIGH → relay energises → load ON.
  2. C charges through R; after T = 1.1RC, VC = ⅔VCC → output LOW → relay de-energises → load OFF automatically.
  3. Pressing RESET at any time makes the output LOW immediately.

Examples of timer applications

  • Staircase / corridor light timer (light ON for 1–2 minutes after pressing a button).
  • Delay timer for washing machines, photographic enlargers, battery chargers, microwave ovens.
  • Power-on delay (e.g. switch on speakers a few seconds after amplifier power-up).
  • Quiz buzzer / game timer, egg timer, auto switch-off for gadgets.
  • Very long delays (minutes to hours) are made by using a 555 astable with a counter IC.
body.gu:
555 નો સૌથી સીધો ઉપયોગ timer તરીકે છે: start signal પછી તે load ને નિશ્ચિત, બદલી શકાય તેવા સમય માટે ON (અથવા OFF) રાખે છે. આ માટે monostable circuit વપરાય છે (monostable circuit આકૃતિ જુઓ).

Circuit ની રચના

  • Timing components R અને C (T = 1.1RC) સાથે monostable 555. સમય બદલવા R ની જગ્યાએ potentiometer + fixed resistor રાખી શકાય.
  • Pin 2 પર START push button (10 kΩ pull-up સાથે) timer ને trigger કરે.
  • Pin 4 પર વૈકલ્પિક STOP / RESET push button (pull-up સાથે) timing ને વહેલું પૂરું કરે.
  • Pin 3 load ને સીધો (LED, buzzer) અથવા lamp જેવા AC loads માટે relay (relay coil ની સમાંતર freewheeling diode સાથે) દ્વારા ચલાવે.

કાર્ય

  1. START દબાવતાં pin 2 ⅓VCC થી નીચે જાય → output HIGH → relay energise થાય → load ON.
  2. C, R દ્વારા charge થાય; T = 1.1RC પછી VC = ⅔VCC → output LOW → relay de-energise થાય → load આપોઆપ OFF.
  3. ગમે ત્યારે RESET દબાવતાં output તરત LOW થાય.

Timer ઉપયોગોના ઉદાહરણો

  • Staircase / corridor light timer (button દબાવ્યા પછી 1–2 મિનિટ light ON).
  • Washing machines, photographic enlargers, battery chargers, microwave ovens માટે delay timer.
  • Power-on delay (દા.ત. amplifier ચાલુ થયા પછી થોડી સેકન્ડે speakers ચાલુ કરવા).
  • Quiz buzzer / game timer, egg timer, gadgets માટે auto switch-off.
  • ખૂબ લાંબા delay (મિનિટો થી કલાકો) 555 astable અને counter IC વાપરીને બનાવાય.

body.en:
A frequency counter measures the frequency of an unknown signal by counting the number of cycles in a known time interval (called the gate time). The 555 timer is used to produce this accurate gate pulse (see block diagram).

fx = N / Tgate (N = number of pulses counted)

If Tgate = 1 s, the count N directly equals the frequency in Hz.

Blocks and working

  1. Wave shaper (Schmitt trigger): converts the unknown input signal (sine, triangular etc.) into clean rectangular pulses of the same frequency.
  2. 555 timer (gate generator): a monostable 555 (or a 555 astable followed by a divider) produces a pulse of exactly known width, e.g. 1 s (T = 1.1RC).
  3. AND gate (main gate): one input gets the shaped pulses and the other gets the gate pulse. Pulses pass through only while the gate pulse is HIGH.
  4. Decade counter: counts the pulses passing through the AND gate. It is reset before each measurement; at the end of the gate time the count is latched.
  5. Decoder / driver and 7-segment display: show the count, i.e. the frequency.

Gate time and range

  • Gate 1 s → reading in Hz; gate 0.1 s → reading × 10; gate 10 ms → reading × 100 (higher frequency, lower resolution).
  • Accuracy depends on the accuracy of the gate time, so stable, low-tolerance R and C are used (crystal-based time bases are used in precision counters).
body.gu:
Frequency counter અજાણ્યા signal ની frequency, જાણીતા સમયગાળા (gate time) માં cycles ની સંખ્યા ગણીને માપે છે. આ ચોક્કસ gate pulse બનાવવા 555 timer વપરાય છે (block diagram જુઓ).

fx = N / Tgate (N = ગણેલા pulses ની સંખ્યા)

Tgate = 1 s હોય તો count N સીધો Hz માં frequency બરાબર થાય.

Blocks અને કાર્ય

  1. Wave shaper (Schmitt trigger): અજાણ્યા input signal (sine, triangular વગેરે) ને તે જ frequency ના સ્વચ્છ rectangular pulses માં ફેરવે.
  2. 555 timer (gate generator): monostable 555 (અથવા divider સાથે 555 astable) બરાબર જાણીતી width નો pulse બનાવે, દા.ત. 1 s (T = 1.1RC).
  3. AND gate (main gate): એક input પર shaped pulses અને બીજા પર gate pulse. Gate pulse HIGH હોય ત્યારે જ pulses પસાર થાય.
  4. Decade counter: AND gate માંથી પસાર થતા pulses ગણે. દરેક માપન પહેલાં reset થાય; gate time ના અંતે count latch થાય.
  5. Decoder / driver અને 7-segment display: count એટલે કે frequency દર્શાવે.

Gate time અને range

  • Gate 1 s → reading Hz માં; gate 0.1 s → reading × 10; gate 10 ms → reading × 100 (વધુ frequency, ઓછું resolution).
  • ચોકસાઈ gate time ની ચોકસાઈ પર આધાર રાખે, તેથી સ્થિર, ઓછા tolerance વાળા R અને C વપરાય (precision counters માં crystal-based time base વપરાય).

h.en: 5.4.8 Other Applications and Comparison of Modes
h.gu: 5.4.8 બીજા ઉપયોગો અને Modes ની સરખામણી

body.en:
Bistable mode (flip-flop)

Pins 6 and 7 are not used for timing (pin 6 grounded); pin 2 (with pull-up) acts as SET and pin 4 (with pull-up) acts as RESET. Pressing SET makes output HIGH and it stays HIGH; pressing RESET makes it LOW. Used as a switch debouncer and ON/OFF touch switch.

Other applications

  • Missing-pulse detector – detects a missing heartbeat / pulse in a pulse train (alarm systems).
  • Frequency divider – monostable with T longer than the input period.
  • PWM and PPM (pulse width / position modulation) – modulating signal at pin 5.
  • Voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) – frequency controlled by pin 5 voltage.
  • Schmitt trigger – pins 2 and 6 joined as input; converts sine into square wave.
  • Burglar / fire alarm, siren, police-siren (two 555s), water-level indicator, traffic-light controller, touch switch, DC-DC voltage doubler.

• Monostable: one pulse per trigger, T = 1.1RC; C charges 0 → ⅔VCC; pins 6 + 7 joined.

q.en: Design a 555 monostable to give a time delay of 5 s using C = 47 µF.
q.gu: C = 47 µF વાપરી 5 s નો time delay આપતો 555 monostable ડિઝાઇન કરો.

a.en:
T = 1.1 RC → R = T / (1.1 C) = 5 / (1.1 × 47 × 10⁻⁶)

= 5 / (51.7 × 10⁻⁶) = 96.7 kΩ

a.en:
Duty cycle: (RA + RB)/(RA + 2RB) = 0.6 → RA + RB = 0.6RA + 1.2RB → 0.4RA = 0.2RB → RB = 2RA

q.en: A 555 timer is operated at V_CC = 9 V. Find the upper and lower threshold voltages. What are they if 5 V is applied at the control pin (pin 5)?

Lower thresholds make the capacitor reach them sooner → timing becomes shorter.

q.en: What is IC 555?

a.gu: Reset active LOW છે; તેને HIGH રાખવાથી noise થી અચાનક reset થતું અટકે.

q.en: Why is a 0.01 µF capacitor connected at pin 5?
q.gu: Pin 5 પર 0.01 µF capacitor કેમ જોડાય છે?

a.en: To bypass noise and ripple so that the threshold voltages remain stable.
a.gu: Noise અને ripple bypass કરવા જેથી threshold voltages સ્થિર રહે.

q.en: What are the two reference voltages inside 555?
q.gu: 555 ની અંદર બે reference voltages કયા છે?

a.en: ⅔V_CC for the upper (threshold) comparator and ⅓V_CC for the lower (trigger) comparator.
a.gu: ઉપરના (threshold) comparator માટે ⅔V_CC અને નીચેના (trigger) comparator માટે ⅓V_CC.

q.en: What is the function of the flip-flop in 555?
q.gu: 555 માં flip-flop નું કાર્ય શું છે?

a.en: It stores the output state; set by the trigger comparator and reset by the threshold comparator.
a.gu: Output state સંગ્રહે; trigger comparator થી set અને threshold comparator થી reset થાય.

q.en: What is the function of the discharge transistor?
q.gu: Discharge transistor નું કાર્ય શું છે?

a.en: When output is LOW it turns ON and discharges the timing capacitor through pin 7.
a.gu: Output LOW હોય ત્યારે ON થઈ pin 7 દ્વારા timing capacitor ને discharge કરે.

q.en: What happens when trigger voltage falls below ⅓V_CC?
q.gu: Trigger voltage ⅓V_CC થી નીચે જાય ત્યારે શું થાય?

a.en: Flip-flop is set and output goes HIGH; discharge transistor turns OFF.
a.gu: Flip-flop set થાય અને output HIGH થાય; discharge transistor OFF થાય.

q.en: What happens when threshold voltage exceeds ⅔V_CC?
q.gu: Threshold voltage ⅔V_CC થી વધે ત્યારે શું થાય?

a.en: Flip-flop is reset and output goes LOW; discharge transistor turns ON.
a.gu: Flip-flop reset થાય અને output LOW થાય; discharge transistor ON થાય.

q.en: What is a multivibrator?
q.gu: Multivibrator એટલે શું?

a.en: A circuit that switches between two states (HIGH and LOW); used to generate rectangular waves or pulses.
a.gu: બે states (HIGH અને LOW) વચ્ચે બદલાતો circuit; rectangular waves અથવા pulses બનાવવા વપરાય.

q.en: How many stable states does a monostable have?
q.gu: Monostable માં કેટલી stable states હોય?

a.en: One stable state (output LOW) and one quasi-stable state.
a.gu: એક stable state (output LOW) અને એક quasi-stable state.

q.en: Why is monostable called a one-shot?
q.gu: Monostable ને one-shot કેમ કહે છે?

a.en: Because it gives exactly one output pulse for each trigger.
a.gu: કારણ કે દરેક trigger માટે બરાબર એક output pulse આપે છે.

q.en: Give the pulse-width formula of a 555 monostable.
q.gu: 555 monostable નું pulse-width formula આપો.

q.en: Does the pulse width depend on V_CC?
q.gu: Pulse width V_CC પર આધાર રાખે છે?

a.en: No. V_CC cancels out in the derivation; T depends only on R and C.
a.gu: ના. Derivation માં V_CC cancel થાય છે; T ફક્ત R અને C પર આધાર રાખે.

q.en: What type of trigger pulse does a 555 monostable need?
q.gu: 555 monostable ને કેવો trigger pulse જોઈએ?

a.en: A negative-going pulse at pin 2 that goes below ⅓V_CC and is shorter than T.
a.gu: Pin 2 પર ⅓V_CC થી નીચે જતો અને T કરતાં ટૂંકો negative-going pulse.

q.en: How many stable states does an astable have?
q.gu: Astable માં કેટલી stable states હોય?

a.en: None – both states are quasi-stable, so it oscillates continuously.
a.gu: એક પણ નહીં – બંને states quasi-stable છે, તેથી સતત oscillate કરે.

q.en: Why is astable called a free-running multivibrator?
q.gu: Astable ને free-running multivibrator કેમ કહે છે?

a.en: Because it produces a continuous output without any external trigger.
a.gu: કારણ કે બહારના trigger વગર સતત output આપે છે.

q.en: Give the frequency formula of a 555 astable.
q.gu: 555 astable નું frequency formula આપો.

q.en: Between which voltages does the capacitor voltage swing in astable mode?
q.gu: Astable mode માં capacitor voltage કયા voltages વચ્ચે ઝૂલે છે?

a.en: Between ⅓V_CC and ⅔V_CC.
a.gu: ⅓V_CC અને ⅔V_CC વચ્ચે.

q.en: What is duty cycle?
q.gu: Duty cycle એટલે શું?

a.en: The ratio of HIGH time to total time period, expressed in %: D = t_H/T × 100.
a.gu: HIGH સમય અને કુલ time period નો ગુણોત્તર, % માં: D = t_H/T × 100.

q.en: Why is the duty cycle of a basic 555 astable always above 50 %?
q.gu: Basic 555 astable નો duty cycle હંમેશા 50 % થી વધુ કેમ હોય?

a.en: Because C charges through R_A + R_B but discharges only through R_B, so t_H > t_L.
a.gu: કારણ કે C, R_A + R_B દ્વારા charge થાય પણ ફક્ત R_B દ્વારા discharge થાય, તેથી t_H > t_L.

q.en: How can 50 % duty cycle be obtained?
q.gu: 50 % duty cycle કેવી રીતે મળે?

a.en: Connect a diode across R_B and make R_A = R_B.
a.gu: R_B ની સમાંતર diode જોડો અને R_A = R_B રાખો.

q.en: Which pins are joined in astable and in monostable mode?
q.gu: Astable અને monostable mode માં કયા pins જોડાય છે?

a.en: Astable: pins 2 and 6. Monostable: pins 6 and 7.
a.gu: Astable: pins 2 અને 6. Monostable: pins 6 અને 7.

q.en: Which mode is used for an LED flasher?
q.gu: LED flasher માટે કયો mode વપરાય?

a.en: Astable mode.
a.gu: Astable mode.

q.en: What is the difference between sourcing and sinking current at pin 3?
q.gu: Pin 3 પર sourcing અને sinking current માં શું તફાવત છે?

a.en: Sourcing: load from pin 3 to ground, ON when output HIGH. Sinking: load from V_CC to pin 3, ON when output LOW.
a.gu: Sourcing: load pin 3 થી ground, output HIGH હોય ત્યારે ON. Sinking: load V_CC થી pin 3, output LOW હોય ત્યારે ON.

q.en: Which mode is used for a timer / time-delay circuit?
q.gu: Timer / time-delay circuit માટે કયો mode વપરાય?

a.en: Monostable mode.
a.gu: Monostable mode.

q.en: What is the role of 555 in a frequency counter?
q.gu: Frequency counter માં 555 ની ભૂમિકા શું છે?

a.en: It generates the accurate gate pulse (e.g. 1 s) during which input pulses are counted.
a.gu: તે ચોક્કસ gate pulse (દા.ત. 1 s) બનાવે છે જે દરમિયાન input pulses ગણાય છે.

q.en: How is frequency calculated in a frequency counter?
q.gu: Frequency counter માં frequency કેવી રીતે ગણાય?

a.en: f = N / T_gate, where N is the number of pulses counted in the gate time.
a.gu: f = N / T_gate, જ્યાં N gate time માં ગણેલા pulses ની સંખ્યા છે.

q.en: Name some applications of 555.
q.gu: 555 ના થોડા ઉપયોગો જણાવો.

a.en: LED flasher, timer, pulse generator, frequency counter, PWM, missing-pulse detector, alarm, siren, VCO.
a.gu: LED flasher, timer, pulse generator, frequency counter, PWM, missing-pulse detector, alarm, siren, VCO.

q.gu: Circuit diagram અને waveforms સાથે monostable multivibrator તરીકે 555 નું કાર્ય સમજાવો.

q.gu: 555 monostable multivibrator માટે T = 1.1RC સૂત્ર સાબિત કરો.

q.gu: 555 astable multivibrator માટે t_H, t_L, frequency અને duty cycle ના સૂત્રો સાબિત કરો.

q.en: Why is the duty cycle of a 555 astable more than 50 %? How can it be made 50 %?
q.gu: 555 astable નો duty cycle 50 % થી વધુ કેમ હોય છે? તેને 50 % કેવી રીતે કરી શકાય?

q.gu: Monostable, astable અને bistable multivibrators ની સરખામણી કરો.
